file: a080/doc.pdf (GEORGIA INTERNATIONAL MINING CORP, SB-2/A EX-99)
coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and drawn rectangles (geom.json in work-g1); tick squares from ink at 400 dpi; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: The subscriber fills the registration table and the kind-of-subscriber choices, ticks how payment is made and signs with the date and printed name; a second subscriber line is printed under the first; the company accepts with a date and the director's signature.

sure_per_page.2: sure (judgements: the nine "( )" pairs are tick boxes; the state after "the State of :" is a place with nothing printed)
sure_per_page.3: sure (judgement: the second signature and print-name lines belong to a second subscriber)

2: the bracketed words "(man) (woman)" and "(his) (her)" inside one choice: words to strike, not tick boxes
the caption cells of the registration table (left column, and the "Postal \ Zip" caption cell)
the dollar sign printed at the start of the amount cell (part of that blank)
the table frames of section 5 (the choices sit inside them)
the footnote line under the registration table
3: the printed name and title of the company director under the acceptance line (already printed)
